# Travel Amin

> Arabic-language website of Amin, a tour guide based in Mashhad, Iran. It offers tourism and medical-travel coordination in Iran for Arabic-speaking travelers. Contact and booking happen directly on WhatsApp; the site has no backend and shows no fixed prices.

Medical travel is consultation and coordination only: no medical advice and no guarantee of results. Prices are not fixed; a quote is given on request via WhatsApp, based on the trip. Based in Mashhad, with 5 years of experience with Arabic-speaking guests. The site is available in Arabic (default, right-to-left) and English.

## Main pages (Arabic)
- [Home](https://travel-amin.github.io/): Arabic homepage (default language, right-to-left)
- [About](https://travel-amin.github.io/#about): Who Amin is and his experience with Arabic-speaking guests
- [Tourism](https://travel-amin.github.io/#tourism): Guide, airport transfer, accommodation suggestions and daily itinerary in Mashhad, Tehran, northern Iran and nature destinations
- [Medical travel](https://travel-amin.github.io/#medical): Coordination for cosmetic surgery, dentistry, fertility treatment and general check-ups
- [Rates](https://travel-amin.github.io/#rates): How pricing works and how to get a quote
- [FAQ](https://travel-amin.github.io/#faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Booking](https://travel-amin.github.io/#booking): How to book a trip
- [Contact](https://travel-amin.github.io/#contact): Contact details
